integrity: The general theorem has a self-contained analytic argument; a standalone exact-rational checker independently tests its six-individual witness and all admissible small-census clade partitions. Existing rarefaction and phylogenetic evenness formulas are expressly acknowledged rather than presented as novel.
scientific_limitations: The all-tree characterization concerns existence of some census and transfer rather than reversal for every population; the six-individual sharp minimum is universal over tree choices, not a bound for each fixed tree. No unrooted/nonultrametric/sampling-with-replacement/uncertain-phylogeny claims. Independent originality and mathematical audit remain unperformed.
scientific_scope: Expected rooted Faith phylogenetic diversity under uniform without-replacement sampling of known finite strictly positive integer abundances on fixed strictly-positive-edge ultrametric phylogenies, evaluated before/after one admissible unit abundance-balancing transfer.
title: Star phylogenies are exactly the ultrametric trees immune to rarefaction losses from abundance balancing
